known_differences.description: fsci-constants provides CODATA physical constants, SI/binary prefixes, unit conversions, lambda2nu/nu2lambda, and convert_temperature.

threats.description: Zero or negative wavelength/frequency passed to lambda2nu / nu2lambda producing division-by-zero Inf without explicit IEEE semantics.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-constants/src/lib.rs:499 (lambda2nu): computes c / lambda using exact CODATA speed_of_light (299792458.0 m/s) matching SciPy.
threats.strict_mode_response: Match SciPy c / lambda IEEE floating-point division.

threats.description: Unknown physical constant key or unsupported temperature scale name passed to value / unit / convert_temperature.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-constants/src/lib.rs:1001 (convert_temperature): normalizes scale names and returns Err(ConstantsError) on unrecognized scale.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return None for unknown constant keys and Err for unknown temperature scales.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Fail closed on unknown scale names without silent fallback.

threats.description: Repeated per-call string allocations during case-insensitive CODATA constant lookup.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-constants/src/lib.rs:957 (value): uses zero-allocation ASCII case-insensitive table lookup over static CODATA entries.
threats.strict_mode_response: Resolve constant value in bounded time without heap allocation.

threats.description: CODATA constant values, units, or relative uncertainties drifting from SciPy's physical_constants table.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-constants/src/lib.rs:970 (unit): serves value, unit, and relative precision from a unified static CODATA metadata table.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return exact CODATA value, unit string, and relative precision.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Verify table uniqueness and alias consistency in unit tests.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return None from value(), unit(), and precision().
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return None without partial prefix guessing.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return Err(ConstantsError::UnknownScale) naming the invalid scale.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: duplicate or ambiguous CODATA table keys

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Perform deterministic substring match over CODATA keys.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Perform deterministic substring match over CODATA keys.
